## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results, and explain any relevant check you
could not run. See CONTRIBUTING.md for the expected checks. Name the platforms
you tested platform-specific changes on.

## Visual and performance changes

For visible changes, attach before/after screenshots in the themes affected. For
changes on a measured path, link updated results under `docs/performance/`.
Remove this section when it does not apply.
